parsed.summary: The patch introduces a method to handle the identity matrix elements correctly, but it may not address all edge cases or potential regressions.

issues.description: The patch only handles the identity matrix case and does not address other types of matrices or potential edge cases.
There is a risk that this change may break existing behavior for other matrix types or operations.
The patch introduces a new method that could be improved for readability and maintainability.
